**Files:** `src/store/assets.rs` (setup acquisition per Ryan's decision — a setup function/command fetches the weights + tokenizer; consumer docs — no CLI changes); `README.md` privacy FAQ; `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs`.

**Acceptance:** per Ryan's decision (BOTSPY-bb60bb closed): a setup step/command downloads the quantized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX weights + tokenizer.json once (content digest verified, download-once/idempotent semantics) and caches them under `~/.botspy/models/` (BOTSPY_MODELS honored); the runtime library makes no network calls and nothing leaves the machine at runtime; clean typed errors when offline and the files are missing; no telemetry. The README privacy claim is updated to state the one-time setup fetch honestly.
